{"summary": "The change modifies ObjectArrayCodec.deserialze in com.alibaba.fastjson.serializer so that when parsing a JSON array, it calls parser.parseArray(componentClass, array, fieldName) instead of parser.parseArray(componentType, array, fieldName). This switches the component type used during array parsing from the generic/raw Type (componentType) to the resolved concrete Class (componentClass), which is derived from clazz.getComponentType(). The intent is to address CVE-2017-18349 (improper input validation) by ensuring array elements are deserialized against the actual component class rather than an unchecked Type, preventing type-confusion or unsafe type resolution during JSON deserialization."}
